sentences.unitTitle: Unit 1 · 礼貌问候与日常交际 (10句)
sentences.en: Hello! My name is Lily.

substitutions.fullEn: Hello! My name is Tom.
Hello! My name is Lucy.

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 1 · 礼貌问候与日常交际 (10句)
sentences.en: Nice to meet you, too.

substitutions.fullEn: Nice to meet you, Miss White.
substitutions.fullZh: 很高兴认识您，怀特老师。

substitutions.fullEn: Nice to meet you, my friend.
substitutions.fullZh: 很高兴认识你，我的朋友。

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 1 · 礼貌问候与日常交际 (10句)
sentences.en: I am nine years old.

substitutions.fullEn: I am eight years old.
I am ten years old.

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 1 · 礼貌问候与日常交际 (10句)
sentences.en: I am fine, thank you.

substitutions.fullEn: I am very happy, thank you.
I am doing great, thank you.

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 1 · 礼貌问候与日常交际 (10句)
sentences.en: I am from Beijing, China.

substitutions.fullEn: I am from Shanghai, China.
I am from London, UK.

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 1 · 礼貌问候与日常交际 (10句)
sentences.en: Good morning, dear teacher!

substitutions.fullEn: Good morning, Mom and Dad!
Good morning, everyone!

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 1 · 礼貌问候与日常交际 (10句)
sentences.en: Thank you for your help!

substitutions.fullEn: Thank you for your gift!
Thank you for your book!

sentences.rolePlayQuestion: Here is a little gift for you.

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 1 · 礼貌问候与日常交际 (10句)
sentences.en: You are very welcome.

substitutions.fullEn: It is my pleasure.
No problem at all.

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 1 · 礼貌问候与日常交际 (10句)
sentences.en: Excuse me, may I come in?
sentences.zh: 打扰一下，我可以进来吗？

substitutions.fullEn: Excuse me, may I ask a question?
substitutions.fullZh: 打扰一下，我可以问个问题吗？

substitutions.fullEn: Excuse me, may I sit here?
substitutions.fullZh: 打扰一下，我可以坐这里吗？

sentences.rolePlayQuestion: Who is knocking at the door?

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 1 · 礼貌问候与日常交际 (10句)
sentences.en: Goodbye! See you tomorrow!

substitutions.fullEn: Goodbye! See you next week!
Goodbye! See you after school!

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 2 · 美食点餐与礼貌请求 (10句)
sentences.en: Can I have some water, please?

substitutions.fullEn: Can I have some bread, please?
Can I have some milk, please?

sentences.rolePlayQuestionZh: 欢迎光临！你想要点什么？

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 2 · 美食点餐与礼貌请求 (10句)
sentences.en: I would like a beef burger.

substitutions.fullEn: I would like some noodles.
I would like an apple pie.

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 2 · 美食点餐与礼貌请求 (10句)
sentences.en: I like red apples very much.

substitutions.fullEn: I like sweet strawberries very much.
I like yellow bananas very much.

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 2 · 美食点餐与礼貌请求 (10句)
sentences.en: My favorite food is ice cream.
sentences.zh: 我最喜欢的食物是冰淇淋。

substitutions.fullEn: My favorite food is roast chicken.
substitutions.fullZh: 我最喜欢的食物是烤鸡。

substitutions.fullEn: My favorite food is fresh fish.
substitutions.fullZh: 我最喜欢的食物是鲜鱼。

sentences.rolePlayQuestionZh: 你最喜欢的食物是什么？

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 2 · 美食点餐与礼貌请求 (10句)
sentences.en: Yes, please. I love orange juice.
sentences.zh: 好的，麻烦了。我很喜欢橙汁。

substitutions.fullEn: Yes, please. I love green tea.
Yes, please. I love hot soup.

sentences.rolePlayQuestion: Would you like some orange juice?

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 2 · 美食点餐与礼貌请求 (10句)
sentences.en: Pass me the spoon, please.

substitutions.fullEn: Pass me the chopsticks, please.
Pass me the dinner plate, please.

sentences.rolePlayQuestion: How can I help you at the table?
sentences.rolePlayQuestionZh: 餐桌上有什么需要帮你的？

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 2 · 美食点餐与礼貌请求 (10句)
sentences.en: The cake tastes so delicious!
sentences.zh: 这块蛋糕尝起来太美味了！

substitutions.fullEn: The watermelon tastes sweet and fresh!
substitutions.fullZh: 西瓜尝起来又甜又新鲜！

substitutions.fullEn: The bread tastes warm and nice!

sentences.rolePlayQuestionZh: 蛋糕尝起来味道怎么样？

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 2 · 美食点餐与礼貌请求 (10句)
sentences.en: Mom, I am a little hungry.

substitutions.fullEn: Mom, I am very thirsty.
Mom, I am full now.

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 2 · 美食点餐与礼貌请求 (10句)
sentences.en: How much is this sandwich?

substitutions.fullEn: How much is this milk?
How much is that cake?

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 2 · 美食点餐与礼貌请求 (10句)
sentences.en: Here is your hot breakfast.

substitutions.fullEn: Here is your fresh salad.
Here is your lunch box.

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 3 · 校园生活与文具物品 (10句)
sentences.en: I have a new schoolbag.

substitutions.fullEn: I have a new pencil box.
I have a new story book.

sentences.rolePlayQuestion: What do you have in your hand?

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 3 · 校园生活与文具物品 (10句)
sentences.en: May I borrow your ruler, please?
sentences.zh: 请问我可以借用一下你的尺子吗？

substitutions.fullEn: May I borrow your eraser, please?
substitutions.fullZh: 请问我可以借用你的橡皮吗？

substitutions.fullEn: May I borrow your blue pen, please?
substitutions.fullZh: 请问我可以借用你的蓝钢笔吗？

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 3 · 校园生活与文具物品 (10句)
sentences.en: Where is my English book?

substitutions.fullEn: Where is my red crayon?
Where is my notebook?

sentences.rolePlayQuestion: Look! It is on the desk.

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 3 · 校园生活与文具物品 (10句)
sentences.pattern: It is in / on / under the ___.
sentences.en: It is under the teacher's desk.

substitutions.fullEn: It is in your schoolbag.
It is on the wooden chair.

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 3 · 校园生活与文具物品 (10句)
sentences.en: My favorite subject is English.
sentences.zh: 我最喜欢的科目是英语。

substitutions.fullEn: My favorite subject is music.
substitutions.fullZh: 我最喜欢的科目是音乐。

substitutions.fullEn: My favorite subject is science.
substitutions.fullZh: 我最喜欢的科目是科学。

sentences.rolePlayQuestion: What subject do you like best?

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 3 · 校园生活与文具物品 (10句)
sentences.en: Let's clean the classroom together!
sentences.zh: 让我们一起打扫教室吧！

substitutions.fullEn: Let's clean the blackboard together!
Let's clean the windows together!

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 3 · 校园生活与文具物品 (10句)
sentences.en: Open your books to page ten.

substitutions.fullEn: Open your books to page twenty.
Open your books to unit three.

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 3 · 校园生活与文具物品 (10句)
sentences.en: Yes, this is my dictionary.

substitutions.fullEn: Yes, this is my water bottle.
Yes, this is my umbrella.

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 3 · 校园生活与文具物品 (10句)
sentences.en: We have art and music today.
sentences.zh: 我们今天有美术课和音乐课。

substitutions.fullEn: We have math and PE today.
substitutions.fullZh: 我们今天有数学课和体育课。

substitutions.fullEn: We have computer class today.

sentences.rolePlayQuestion: What classes do we have today?

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 3 · 校园生活与文具物品 (10句)
sentences.en: Listen to the teacher carefully.

substitutions.fullEn: Read the English text aloud.
Please raise your hand first.

sentences.rolePlayQuestionZh: 我们的课堂规则是什么？

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 4 · 家庭成员与兴趣运动 (10句)
sentences.en: This is my loving family.

substitutions.fullEn: This is my kind father.
This is my pretty mother.

sentences.rolePlayQuestion: Who are they in the photo?

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 4 · 家庭成员与兴趣运动 (10句)
sentences.en: My father is a busy doctor.
sentences.zh: 我的爸爸是一名忙碌的医生。

substitutions.fullEn: My mother is a great teacher.
substitutions.fullZh: 我的妈妈是一名优秀的老师。

substitutions.fullEn: My uncle is a brave driver.
substitutions.fullZh: 我的叔叔是一名勇敢的司机。

sentences.rolePlayQuestionZh: 你爸爸是做什么工作的？

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 4 · 家庭成员与兴趣运动 (10句)
sentences.en: I can play basketball very well.

substitutions.fullEn: I can swim very fast.
I can sing English songs well.

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 4 · 家庭成员与兴趣运动 (10句)
sentences.en: Yes, I can play football.

substitutions.fullEn: Yes, I can play ping-pong.
Yes, I can play the piano.

sentences.rolePlayQuestion: Can you play football with me?
sentences.rolePlayQuestionZh: 你能和我一起踢足球吗？

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 4 · 家庭成员与兴趣运动 (10句)
sentences.en: I like reading storybooks at home.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢在家里读故事书。

substitutions.fullEn: I like drawing cartoons at home.
substitutions.fullZh: 我喜欢在家里画卡通画。

substitutions.fullEn: I like riding my bike in the park.
substitutions.fullZh: 我喜欢在公园里骑自行车。

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 4 · 家庭成员与兴趣运动 (10句)
sentences.en: Let's play badminton after school!
sentences.zh: 放学后我们一起打羽毛球吧！

substitutions.fullEn: Let's fly a kite in the park!
Let's jump rope on the playground!

sentences.rolePlayQuestion: What shall we do after school?
sentences.rolePlayQuestionZh: 放学后我们玩什么好呢？

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 4 · 家庭成员与兴趣运动 (10句)
sentences.pattern: There are ___ people in my family.
sentences.en: There are four people in my family.

substitutions.fullEn: There are three people in my family.
There are five people in my family.

sentences.rolePlayQuestion: How many people are there in your family?

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 4 · 家庭成员与兴趣运动 (10句)
sentences.en: I often help my mom wash dishes.

substitutions.fullEn: I often help my mom sweep the floor.
I often help my mom water the flowers.

sentences.rolePlayQuestionZh: 你在家里会帮爸妈做家务吗？

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 4 · 家庭成员与兴趣运动 (10句)
sentences.pattern: She has ___ hair and big eyes.
sentences.en: My sister has long hair and big eyes.
sentences.zh: 我的妹妹有一头长发和大眼睛。

substitutions.fullEn: My brother has short hair and bright eyes.
substitutions.fullZh: 我弟弟留着短发，有一双明亮的眼睛。

substitutions.fullEn: My friend wears cute glasses.
substitutions.fullZh: 我的朋友戴着可爱的眼镜。

sentences.rolePlayQuestion: What does your sister look like?

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 4 · 家庭成员与兴趣运动 (10句)
sentences.en: We play games in the living room.
sentences.zh: 我们在客厅里一起做游戏。

substitutions.fullEn: We read books in the quiet study.
substitutions.fullZh: 我们在安静的书房里看书。

substitutions.fullEn: We make dinner in the kitchen.

sentences.rolePlayQuestionZh: 你们现在在哪个房间玩？

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 5 · 日常作息与天气穿搭 (10句)
sentences.en: It is time to go to school.

substitutions.fullEn: It is time to have dinner.
It is time to go to bed.

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 5 · 日常作息与天气穿搭 (10句)
sentences.en: I get up at seven o'clock.

substitutions.fullEn: I do my homework at five o'clock.
I go to sleep at nine o'clock.

sentences.rolePlayQuestion: When do you get up every day?

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 5 · 日常作息与天气穿搭 (10句)
sentences.en: It is sunny and warm today.

substitutions.fullEn: It is windy and cool today.
It is snowy and cold today.

sentences.rolePlayQuestion: What is the weather like today?

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 5 · 日常作息与天气穿搭 (10句)
sentences.en: It is cold. Put on your coat.
sentences.zh: 天冷了，穿上你的外套吧。

substitutions.fullEn: It is cold. Put on your warm hat.
substitutions.fullZh: 天冷了，戴上你暖和的帽子吧。

substitutions.fullEn: It is raining. Put on your rain boots.
substitutions.fullZh: 下雨了，穿上你的雨靴吧。

sentences.rolePlayQuestion: It is windy outside. What should I wear?

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 5 · 日常作息与天气穿搭 (10句)
sentences.en: I like spring because of the flowers.
sentences.zh: 我最喜欢春天，因为百花盛开。

substitutions.fullEn: I like summer because I can swim.
substitutions.fullZh: 我喜欢夏天，因为我可以去游泳。

substitutions.fullEn: I like winter because of the snow.
substitutions.fullZh: 我喜欢冬天，因为可以玩雪。

sentences.rolePlayQuestion: Which season do you like best?

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 5 · 日常作息与天气穿搭 (10句)
sentences.en: This blue sweater is mine.
sentences.zh: 这件蓝色的毛衣是我的。

substitutions.fullEn: This white shirt is my father's.
substitutions.fullZh: 这件白衬衫是我爸爸的。

substitutions.fullEn: This pink dress is my sister's.
substitutions.fullZh: 这条粉色连衣裙是我妹妹的。

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 5 · 日常作息与天气穿搭 (10句)
sentences.en: Today is Friday. Tomorrow is Saturday!
sentences.zh: 今天是星期五，明天就是星期六啦！

substitutions.fullEn: Today is Monday. Let's work hard!
substitutions.fullZh: 今天是星期一，我们努力学习吧！

substitutions.fullEn: Today is Sunday. Let's go out!
substitutions.fullZh: 今天是星期日，我们出去玩吧！

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 5 · 日常作息与天气穿搭 (10句)
sentences.en: It is rainy. Take your umbrella!
sentences.zh: 外面下雨了，记得带上你的雨伞！

substitutions.fullEn: It is sunny. Take your sunglasses!
substitutions.fullZh: 太阳很大，带上你的太阳镜！

substitutions.fullEn: It is hot. Take your water bottle!
substitutions.fullZh: 天气很热，带上你的水壶！

sentences.rolePlayQuestion: I am going outside now, Mom!

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 5 · 日常作息与天气穿搭 (10句)
sentences.en: I brush my teeth every morning.

substitutions.fullEn: I wash my face every morning.
I comb my hair every morning.

sentences.rolePlayQuestion: What do you do after getting up?

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 5 · 日常作息与天气穿搭 (10句)
sentences.en: Good night! Sweet dreams to you!
sentences.zh: 晚安！祝你做个甜甜的美梦！

substitutions.fullEn: Have a wonderful weekend!
substitutions.fullZh: 祝你度过一个愉快的周末！

substitutions.fullEn: Have a safe and happy trip!

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 6 · 动物世界与问路出行 (10句)
sentences.en: Look at that cute panda!
sentences.zh: 快看那只可爱的大熊猫！

substitutions.fullEn: Look at that tall giraffe!
substitutions.fullZh: 快看那只高高的长颈鹿！

substitutions.fullEn: Look at that clever monkey!
substitutions.fullZh: 快看那只聪明的小猴子！

sentences.rolePlayQuestion: What do you see in the zoo?
sentences.rolePlayQuestionZh: 你在动物园里看到了什么？

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 6 · 动物世界与问路出行 (10句)
sentences.en: The elephant has a long nose.
sentences.zh: 大象有一条长长的鼻子。

substitutions.fullEn: The rabbit has two long ears.
substitutions.fullZh: 小兔子有两只长长的耳朵。

substitutions.fullEn: The bird has colorful wings.
substitutions.fullZh: 这只小鸟有五彩缤纷的翅膀。

sentences.rolePlayQuestion: Why is the elephant so special?

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 6 · 动物世界与问路出行 (10句)
sentences.en: I go to school by bus.

substitutions.fullEn: I go to school by subway.
I walk to school every day.

sentences.rolePlayQuestion: How do you go to school?

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 6 · 动物世界与问路出行 (10句)
sentences.pattern: Stop and wait at a ___ light.
sentences.en: Stop and wait at a red light.
sentences.zh: 红灯亮时请停下来等待。

substitutions.fullEn: Go at a green traffic light.
substitutions.fullZh: 绿灯亮时可以安全通行。

substitutions.fullEn: Slow down at a yellow light.

sentences.rolePlayQuestionZh: 过马路的交通规则是什么？

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 6 · 动物世界与问路出行 (10句)
sentences.en: Excuse me, where is the library?
sentences.zh: 打扰一下，请问图书馆在哪里？

substitutions.fullEn: Excuse me, where is the city park?
substitutions.fullZh: 打扰一下，请问城市公园在哪里？

substitutions.fullEn: Excuse me, where is the post office?
substitutions.fullZh: 打扰一下，请问邮局在哪里？

sentences.rolePlayQuestion: How can I help you, little boy?
sentences.rolePlayQuestionZh: 小朋友，有什么可以帮你的吗？

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 6 · 动物世界与问路出行 (10句)
sentences.en: Go straight and turn left here.
sentences.zh: 一直往前走，然后在这里左转。

substitutions.fullEn: Go straight and turn right at the corner.
substitutions.fullZh: 直走然后在路口向右转。

substitutions.fullEn: It is right next to the hospital.

sentences.rolePlayQuestion: How can I get to the bookstore?

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 6 · 动物世界与问路出行 (10句)
sentences.pattern: I am going to ___ this weekend.
sentences.en: I am going to visit my grandparents.
sentences.zh: 这个周末我要去看望爷爷奶奶。

substitutions.fullEn: I am going to take a train trip.
I am going to see a funny film.
substitutions.fullZh: 我要去看一场有趣的电影。

sentences.rolePlayQuestion: What are you going to do this weekend?
sentences.rolePlayQuestionZh: 你这个周末打算做什么？

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 6 · 动物世界与问路出行 (10句)
sentences.en: I can see twelve white sheep.
sentences.zh: 我能看到十二只白色的小绵羊。

substitutions.fullEn: I can see fifteen yellow ducks.
substitutions.fullZh: 我能看到十五只小黄鸭。

substitutions.fullEn: I can see twenty strong horses.
substitutions.fullZh: 我能看到二十匹强壮的骏马。

sentences.rolePlayQuestion: How many sheep are there on the farm?

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 6 · 动物世界与问路出行 (10句)
sentences.en: The birds are singing in the tree.
sentences.zh: 小鸟们正在树上唱歌呢。

substitutions.fullEn: The rabbits are jumping on the grass.
substitutions.fullZh: 小兔子们正在草地上蹦蹦跳跳。

substitutions.fullEn: The fish are swimming in the river.
substitutions.fullZh: 小鱼们正在河里游来游去。

sentences.rolePlayQuestion: Listen! What are the birds doing?

sentences.unitTitle: Unit 6 · 动物世界与问路出行 (10句)
sentences.en: Animals are our good friends.

substitutions.fullEn: Let's keep the green park clean!
substitutions.fullZh: 让我们保持绿色公园的整洁！

substitutions.fullEn: Let's love and protect nature!
substitutions.fullZh: 让我们热爱并保护大自然！

sentences.rolePlayQuestion: What did you learn at the zoo today?
sentences.rolePlayQuestionZh: 今天在动物园你学到了什么？
